admission.justification: The two kinds are realized in the schema module, the folder registry and the ID registry at once, and each is consumed by a reader, a writer and a validator that must agree on the same names.

applicability: Every memory tree that holds a weakness or a dependent record, including a tree that holds neither, which reads and validates as before; a dependent without deferrals stays byte-identical.
conditions: The record is written through the curator writer, which resolves weakness anchors, confirmation link values, and deferral condition.file blobs at the task's tip.

When present, deferrals is a non-empty list of uniquely identified entries, each requiring a passage, reason, owner, condition with at least one of task or file, and fileBlob exactly when condition.file is set.
exclusions: A limitation, which bounds what an invariant claims and stays a limitation.
A weakness that belongs to no file of the repository, which is not recorded in this kind.

evidence: R4-verdict.md per-ID closures F01/F02/F16; mcp/tests/test_mik_r118_r124_marks.py writer cases

statement: The memory holds two record kinds beside the ten kinds it already has: a weakness, which names the code place whose waste, fault or debt it records, and a dependent, which names one document, every place that document stands on, and any open explicit deferrals (omitted when empty).
title: Memory stores weaknesses and dependents with optional explicit deferrals
